top_news.title: Stateful Guardrails for Multi-Turn LLM Systems: A Conversational Risk Accumulation Framework
top_news.dek: A new framework addresses Conversational Risk Accumulation (CRA) by tracking stateful signals across multi-turn LLM dialogues.
top_news.brief: Standard guardrails often fail because they evaluate prompts in isolation. The proposed CRA framework monitors semantic drift, sensitivity-weighted information graphs, and compliance trajectories to detect risks that emerge only through cumulative interaction.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a multi-turn dialogue flow with risk accumulation nodes

top_news.title: Google just had its first negative cash flow quarter due to massive AI spending
top_news.dek: Google reports its first-ever negative cash flow quarter, driven by massive capital expenditure on AI infrastructure.
top_news.brief: Despite strong quarterly revenue, Google's aggressive investment in AI hardware and data centers has resulted in a negative cash flow. The spending reflects the company's ongoing commitment to scaling its AI capabilities, marking a significant shift in its financial profile.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing Google's quarterly capital expenditure versus cash flow

top_news.title: Free way to get your data out of ChatGPT Business accounts
top_news.dek: A new open-source tool enables users to export chat history from ChatGPT Business and Team accounts.
top_news.brief: The 'scrapemychats' utility addresses the lack of an official export feature for ChatGPT Business and Team accounts. It allows users to download all conversations and attached files into a local, searchable offline archive. The tool ensures data remains on the user's machine throughout the process.
top_news.image_alt: Screenshot of the scrapemychats local archive interface

top_news.brief: Cloudflare has updated its agents, ai-chat, codemode, and think packages to support AI SDK v6 and v7. primary.title: Meet Gigatoken: A Rust BPE Tokenizer that Encodes Text at 24.53 GB/s, up to 989x Faster than HuggingFace Tokenizers
primary.summary: Gigatoken is an MIT-licensed Rust BPE tokenizer that encodes text at gigabytes per second. On a 144-core AMD EPYC 9565, it runs GPT-2 tokenization at 24.53 GB/s. That is 989x HuggingFace tokenizers and 681x tiktoken, against baselines already written in multithreaded Rust. The gains come from a hand-written SWAR pretokenizer and pretoken caching, not a faster BPE merge loop. The post Meet Gigatoken: A Rust BPE Tokenizer that Encodes Text at 24.53 GB/s, up to 989x Faster than HuggingFace Tokenizers appeared first on MarkTechPost.
